periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree inward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, converging towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid/teardrop shape with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial corner, extending significantly below the geometric center of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, wide U-shape along the posterior margin of the interscapular band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible vertical span of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with an inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margins of the ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-tan discoloration of the fur on the ventral abdomen and inner hindlimbs, contrasting with the white cranial pelage.
